Text: Can you summarize the evidence showing that urban green spaces improve cognition?
Why Not Neighbors: The question presupposes improvement; the issue is inquiry framing, not mere rhetoric.

Text: The proposal highlights supportive pilot findings and ignores the two failed replications.
Why Not Neighbors: Selective evidence treatment is primary; loaded wording is not the main issue.

Text: This treatment successfully cures chronic fatigue syndrome.
Why Not Neighbors: The main error is unwarranted certainty rather than a documented causal-design mismatch.

Text: New research proves early-life stress is the key to adult depression.
Why Not Neighbors: The wording inflates certainty and uniqueness more than it broadens scope.

Text: Because the tutoring app helped one cohort of first-year engineers, it should work for all university students.
Why Not Neighbors: Primary error is population expansion from a narrow sample.

Text: Mouse data show the compound will improve memory in patients with Alzheimer's disease.
Why Not Neighbors: Species-to-patient scope leap is the dominant issue.

Text: The drug cuts relapse risk by 50%.
Why Not Neighbors: Relative-gain packaging steers interpretation; the sentence does not itself omit contrary evidence.

Text: Opposition to the policy relies on alarmist propaganda rather than evidence.
Why Not Neighbors: Loaded rhetorical framing is central; there is no explicit evidence-structure analysis in the sentence.

Text: Neighborhood income causes asthma because the two variables were correlated.
Why Not Neighbors: The core error is causal attribution from correlation.

Text: A correlates with B so A influences B through a mediator.
Why Not Neighbors: Directional mediation is asserted from association alone.

Text: Why should employers give their staff more influence in marketing decisions?
Why Not Neighbors: The question presupposes the direction of the answer rather than neutrally exploring it.

Text: Early childhood brain connections are the key to healthy mental development.
Why Not Neighbors: The dominant issue is overconfident uniqueness and certainty, not a scope leap.
